create_DynamicCRF_layer: create a DynamicCRF layer with a given vocab size, low rank, and beam size
compute_log_likelihood_forward: compute the conditional log-likelihood of target sequences given emission scores using the CRF forward pass
decode_sequence_forward_decoder: decode the most likely output sequence from emission scores using beam Viterbi decoding
compute_transition_score_compute_score: compute the joint score of emission and low-rank transition scores for a target sequence
approximate_normalizer_compute_normalize: approximate the CRF partition function using beam search over top-k emission scores
